entries.title: Wait arrows and task parts keep up with a long task list
entries.body: Once your tasks list grew past about 500 tasks, the arrows between waiting crewmates and the drawing of a task split into parts could stop changing. They now update whenever a wait is added or removed or a part is dropped, however long the list is.
entries.noPicture: The stage looks as it already did with fewer tasks; the fix is that it keeps changing with many.
